question: ________ choreographed famous song 'Kahe Chhed Mohe' from the movie Devdas and 'Mohe Rang Do Laal' from Bajirao Mastani.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Birju Maharaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Bollywood song "Mohe Rang Do Laal" from Bajirao Mastani was choreographed by Birju Maharaj.
 
• He was honoured with the Filmfare Award for Best Choreography in 2016 for his work on Deepika Padukone's performance in Bajirao Mastani.
 
• Pandit Birju Maharaj, an Indian dancer, composer, vocalist, and representative of the Lucknow "Kalka-Bindadin" Gharana of Kathak dance, lived from 4 February 1938 to 16 January 2022.
 
• He was a member of the Maharaj family of Kathak dancers, which included his father and master, Acchan Maharaj, as well as his two uncles, Shambhu Maharaj and Lachhu Maharaj.
 
• He was a vocalist and also studied Hindustani classical music.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bajirao Mastani

 
 
• ​Sanjay Leela Bhansali is the director of the 2015 Indian epic historical romance film Bajirao Mastani.
 
• He also co-produced the movie alongside Eros International and wrote the soundtrack.
 
• In addition to Tanvi Azmi, Vaibhav Tatwawaadi, Milind Soman, Mahesh Manjrekar, and Priyanka Chopra, the movie also stars Ranveer Singh, Deepika Padukone, and Priyanka Chopra in supporting parts.
 
• The Maratha Peshwa Bajirao I (1700–1740 AD) and his second wife, Mastani, are the subjects of the Marathi novel Rau by Nagnath S. Inamdar, which served as the basis for the film Bajirao Mastani.
